blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre a alegoria da caverna a partir de um poema, interpretando imagens e personificação e controlando o ritmo.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Leaving the Cave
lines: They taught us the shadows by name:
the tall one, the stag, the hunter’s hound.
We nodded, each in his own small light,
and called the flicker knowledge.
One turned. The fire stung like a verdict.
She climbed, half blind, toward a noise like wind,
and the sun, that tyrant of clarity,
asked, gently, what she meant by “seen”.
Come back, they said. Tell us what is real.
She stood between the dark and the dawn
and found that no word fitted either.

items.q: The prisoners know the shadows only by name.
items.why: taught us the shadows by name.

items.q: The sun is portrayed as a harsh judge.
The woman finds the right words for both dark and dawn.

blocks.body: Na leitura em voz alta, **não pare** no fim do verso quando a frase continua (*enjambment*). Marque a pausa onde há **ponto** (↘) e deixe a voz **suspensa** na vírgula (→).
*Like* pode ser verbo (*I like it*), preposição (*like wind*) ou conjunção informal. No símile é preposição.

items.s: They ___ us the shadows by name. (teach)
The sun ___ , gently, what she meant. (ask)
She stood ___ the dark and the dawn. (between)

items.pt: E o sol perguntando com gentileza?

items.ans: Where would you pause in line five
items.pt: Onde você pausaria no verso cinco?

body: **Shed light on.** — Esclarecer.
**In a new light.** — Sob nova luz.
**Cast a shadow over.** — Lançar sombra sobre.
**See the light.** — Enxergar a luz.
**Out of the shadows.** — Sair das sombras.
**Open one’s eyes to.** — Abrir os olhos para.
**Dazzled by.** — Deslumbrado por.
**Break free.** — Libertar-se.
**Dawn on someone.** — Ocorrer a alguém.
**Between a rock and a hard place.** — Entre a cruz e a espada.
**Where would you pause in line five?** — Onde você pausaria no verso cinco?
**After “verdict”, where the period falls.** — Depois de “verdict”, onde cai o ponto.
**And the sun asking gently?** — E o sol perguntando com gentileza?

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances

items.label: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances
items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: “Stung like a verdict” is a simile.
The sun asks a question; that is personification.
She climbed, half blind, toward a noise like wind, and the sun…

blocks.task: Write a short poem (8 lines) that retells a philosophical idea as an image, with one simile and one personification.
blocks.model: The clock leans over my shoulder like a patient teacher. It says nothing; it only points. The hours queue at the door and wait to be spent. I pocket one and it dissolves into steam. Time, that quiet landlord, asks for rent. I pay in questions. He accepts them all.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
